cards.title: No real-money purchases
cards.body: Every currency, including Comets and Sigils, is earned in the game. Wisps, upgrades and cosmetics do not require real-money purchases.

cards.title: Keep your permanent upgrades
cards.body: Ascend trades your current run progress for the Prism reward shown on the Ascend screen. Rarity, Rift Forge upgrades, completed Lab projects and Tree upgrades stay with you. If a boss is too strong, you can Farm for resources and improve your party.

cards.title: Automatic combat, with clear limits
cards.body: Your Wisps fight automatically. Returning simulates up to 12 hours of offline combat, using your saved upgrades and automation. Offline Lumen and Shard earnings start at 70% and can improve through Tree upgrades and Lab projects.

cards.title: Discover Wisps as you progress
cards.body: Wisps become available as you reach their Rift unlocks. Recruit them with Lumen and choose your Active Formation. Benched Wisps do not fight.

cards.title: No loot boxes, no gacha
cards.body: Upgrade prices and effects are shown before you buy. Luminous enemies have a chance to appear, but their Mote reward is fixed for the Rift depth and current bonuses, rather than rolled from a random range.

cards.title: Different roles, automatic abilities
cards.body: Active Wisps deal passive damage and automatically use their abilities when their resource bars fill. Their roles provide damage, Support buffs or extra resources. Guardian Tap is the damage you deal by tapping the enemy.

cards.title: Manual taps have a rate limit
cards.body: The game accepts at most 20 manual taps in a one-second window and ignores clicks generated by page scripts. Auto-Tap is a separate in-game unlock earned through Deeds.

mechanicsEvidence.motes: motesDropFor(depth), supportMoteBonus(), fixed rounded reward; eliteChance(depth) controls encounters
